name: benjitaylor/skills
works_with: Coding agents that install skills with `npx skills`, in a React project
short: Benji Taylor's AI skills for design and motion. Its one skill, Stageshow, has your agent build faux product UI in React.
what: A small collection of the skills Benji Taylor uses with coding agents for design and motion work. Right now it holds one: Stageshow. It helps your agent build faux product UI that looks like the real product, as stills, feature cards, cursor demos and bento grids, in React. It comes with guidance on composition and motion, a kit to copy from, examples, and tools that film the result so the agent can check its work.
who: Developers and designers who need product illustrations or animated walkthroughs for a marketing page, feature card or docs hero. The kit is React, so skip it if you don't work in React.
needs: Node and npm (the preview needs Node 20.19 or later)
React 18 or later in the project you copy the kit into
Chrome installed locally, or `CHROME_PATH` set, for the filming tools

steps.title: Optional: preview the examples
steps.text: From the `stageshow` folder. On macOS and Linux open http://stageshow.localhost:1355. On Windows, open the local URL Vite prints.

steps.title: Use the kit in your project
steps.text: Copy `kit/` into your React project. Its components import their own CSS.
steps.code: import { Stage, Window, type Act } from './kit'

steps.title: Check the result
steps.text: The skill films the demo and checks it. `--gate` prints a verdict, and the skill does not hand over until it says `rehearsal passed`.

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text: Ask for a mocked product UI or an animated cursor walkthrough of your app, for example a hero illustration for a feature card. The skill starts from the closest gold example, such as `static-card` or `hero-demo`.

watch: These are drawn illustrations. A scripted `a.click()` only draws the cursor pressing. They do not automate real application controls.
Some real-product studies in `examples/` import `lucide-react`. If you copy one into another project, install that icon package or swap the icons.
Each skill has its own licence and third-party asset notices. Stageshow's are in `NOTICE.md`.
